validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
  <state id="orphan">
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

notes: reachability assumes every event can arrive and every `cond` can be true; no reachable transition, `initial`, or history default enters this state or any of its descendants
diagnostics.help: target `orphan` from a transition of a reachable state, make it the initial state of the <scxml> root, or remove it
spec_references: SCXML 1.0 §3.11 Legal State Configurations and Specifications
